 WorkElate | Full time | Recommended experience 1–2 years

 WorkElate is building an AI native Work OS with a shared organisational brain across everyday office applications. Our goal is to turn intent, knowledge and decisions into coordinated execution while keeping people in control of consequential actions. 
 The role 
 We are looking for technically strong, research oriented engineers who enjoy investigating hard problems and building dependable software. You will work on AI systems, office applications or their intersection, taking ideas from experiments to features people can use in their daily work. 
 What you will do 
 Design and build AI driven workflows across documents, spreadsheets, slides, mail, calendar and tasks. 
 Investigate models, retrieval, memory and tool execution, or build structured editing, collaboration and import and export capabilities 
 Compare approaches through reproducible experiments; measure quality, latency, cost and failure behaviour. 
 Build reliable APIs and application logic with validation, permissions, approval controls, retries, audit trails and recovery.

 What we are looking for 
 Strong programming in Javascript; solid understanding of APIs, databases, data structures, debugging and testing. 
 Hands on depth in either LLM applications and evaluation, or complex web applications such as editors, spreadsheets or collaborative tools. 
 Evidence of research thinking: a well investigated project, experiments, open source contributions or a technical writeup. A research degree is optional. 
 Ability to explain tradeoffs, question assumptions and take ownership from problem discovery through delivery. 
 Useful additional experience 
 React and Node.js; retrieval and agent systems; document formats; spreadsheet engines; real time collaboration; distributed systems; observability; or evaluating AI output quality. You do not need experience in every area. 
 How to apply and what to expect 
 Share your CV, a repository or technical writeup, and a short description of a difficult problem you solved, including what failed and what you learned. Private project walkthroughs are welcome. jobs.description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer on the Grok Connectors team at SpaceXAI, you'll build the integrations that let Grok, Cursor and Grok Bot do real work inside the tools people use every day: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar and Drive, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint, GitHub, Slack, finance accounts, and a fast-growing marketplace of third-party MCP plugins. You'll architect, implement, and deploy features end to end, from OAuth sign-in and token handling, to tool schemas and reliability across hundreds of millions of tool calls, to the cards and approval flows users see on web, desktop, and mobile. You'll work directly with enterprise customers and partners to ship connectors that large organizations can trust.




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You have an entrepreneurial spirit and love creating outsized business impact.

 - You want AI agents to be genuinely useful, by connecting them to real data and real actions safely.

 - You have deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC and of large provider APIs like Google Workspace and Microsoft Graph, or you're excited to become the expert.

 - You care about reliability: concurrency, retries, rate limits, and observability. You fix root causes, not symptoms.

 - You let data decide what to work on. You size user impact from logs and metrics, and you measure error rates before and after every fix.

 - You're strong in TypeScript and comfortable shipping across backend services and client UI in a large codebase.

 - You enjoy working with customers, partners, QA, and support, and can answer a security review question as clearly as you can fix a bug.

 - Bonus: experience with the MCP protocol, Rust, Kubernetes and multi-cloud deployments, enterprise security and compliance (ZDR, audit logs, Conditional Access), or building LLM agents for automation.




SAMPLE PROJECTS INCLUDE

 - Building an automated triage system that pulls user reports from feedback channels, groups them by root cause with user-impact estimates, files issues, and starts a first-pass coding agent on each fix

 - Redesigning OAuth token refresh so concurrent requests never burn a single-use refresh token and mark a working connector as disconnected

 - Cutting hundreds of thousands of daily tool-call errors by generating tool definitions from vendors' published API specs, fixing argument mapping, and adding batch tools

 - Shipping Gmail and Outlook draft, reply, and attachment flows, with approval cards so an agent never sends an email without the user's sign-off

 - Launching new partner connectors, from debugging a partner's OAuth metadata to rollout and adoption metrics

 - Making connectors work for enterprise and single-tenant deployments: custom certificate authorities, Entra Conditional Access, admin controls, and compliance reviews with large financial institutions




APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

jobs.description:
Role Description
 Purpose
Own end-to-end features and production issues spanning the backend API layer and the frontend UI, with a specific charter to hunt down non-obvious performance bottlenecks (slow queries, N+1 patterns, pagination/caching mismatches, render-blocking UI work) and resolve complex, ambiguous defects that don't have a textbook fix.
Key Responsibilities
Design and build features across the layered backend and the feature-based frontend.
Diagnose full-stack performance issues end-to-end — from AG-Grid/React Query data-fetching patterns in the UI, through FastAPI endpoint contracts, down to the database — and identify root cause rather than symptoms.
Apply out-of-the-box thinking to intermittent, hard-to-reproduce, or cross-system defects: correlate logs, telemetry, and health-check data; form hypotheses; validate with targeted experiments instead of guesswork.
Implement secure, tested endpoints following the response pattern (success/error), auth rules (JWT, role checks on mutating endpoints), and validation rules (Pydantic, 422 on invalid input).
Build accessible, performant Carbon-based UI components with proper loading/error states, 4px-grid spacing, and scoped CSS.
Write unit/integration tests (pytest for backend, Vitest/RTL for frontend) covering both correctness and performance regressions.
Use GenAI code-generation and test assistants to accelerate delivery safely, with peer review and security checks on all AI-assisted output.
Contribute to observability: structured logging, error handling, and lineage/traceability of data issues.
Must-Have Skills
Strong Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, raw SQL — no ORM) and strong TypeScript/React (Carbon Design System, Zustand, React Query, Vite).
Proven track record diagnosing production performance issues: query optimization, connection pooling, pagination/caching design, and frontend rendering/data-fetching bottlenecks.
Comfortable reading and correlating evidence across layers — API contracts, DB query plans, browser network/render traces, and application logs — to find root cause on ambiguous, cross-cutting bugs.
Solid grasp of JWT-based auth, role-based access control, and secure coding practices (OWASP-aware).
Experience with AWS services relevant to the stack (Lambda, Fargate, Secrets Manager).
Testing discipline: pytest, Vitest/React Testing Library, and willingness to add regression tests for every non-trivial fix.
Familiarity with automotive procurement / multi-tier supply chain domain concepts is a plus, not a blocker.
KPIs / Success Measures
Reduction in P95/P99 latency on flagged slow endpoints and UI views after intervention.
Mean time to root-cause and resolve complex/ambiguous production defects.
Escaped defect rate trending down; regression tests added per fixed bug.
Story throughput and code quality (review turnaround, test coverage) maintained alongside performance work.
Common Requirements (emphasis for this role)
Emphasis: cross-layer performance diagnosis, root-cause analysis on complex/ambiguous issues, and disciplined, tested delivery across both backend and frontend.
Proficient, responsible use of GenAI coding assistants (with unit tests, security checks, and peer review) to accelerate — not replace — sound engineering judgment.
Quality, observability, and cost-awareness (FinOps) expected on all delivered work.

* Hands-on experience building Voice AI applications or conversational AI systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience building applications using LLMs and LLM APIs.
* Experience with at least some of these: OpenAI Realtime, Livekit, SIP Trunking, Langfuse, AWS
* Understanding of STT, TTS, VAD, turn detection, interruptions and real-time audio pipelines.
* Experience with APIs, WebSockets and asynchronous systems.
* Understanding of agentic workflows, tool calling and prompt engineering.
* Comfortable working with databases and cloud infrastructure.
* Ability to independently build and ship production features.

Strong Plus

  

* Built a production Voice AI agent handling real customer calls.
* Experience reducing end-to-end voice latency and improving conversational quality.
* Experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, MCP or agent memory.
* Experience building evaluation frameworks for LLM/Voice AI systems.
* Experience with AWS and production backend infrastructure.
* Startup experience where you have built products from scratch.

What Matters Most

We are not looking for someone who has only experimented with LLM APIs.

We want an engineer who has actually built AI systems and ideally has worked on Voice AI in production.

You should be able to take a problem such as:

"Build an AI agent that can call a lead, understand their intent, answer questions, qualify them and update the CRM."

…and independently figure out how to build and ship it.

You Will Thrive Here If

You enjoy building more than researching.

You are excited about Voice AI, LLMs and agentic systems.

You move fast and are comfortable figuring things out independently.

You care about production reliability, not just demos.

You want your engineering work to directly impact real customer and revenue outcomes.

You want significant ownership early in your career.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.  Elastic Observability is building a system that monitors production environments the way an expert SRE would: it learns what normal looks like across logs, metrics, and traces, generates its own detection queries, identifies when something meaningful changes, and launches autonomous investigations — without waiting for a human to notice first.
